eras.title: Faces above the galleries
eras.caption: At the Bayon, carved faces rise above galleries and passages in the centre of Angkor Thom. The sandstone towers belong to a city whose temples, reservoirs and roads formed a far larger inhabited landscape than the monuments alone suggest.
